p.scope-of-this-document: **Scope of this document.** This file defines the *record half* of a campaign: flipping the status line, the execution-record block, the per-phase commit maps, the honesty rules, the closing report, and the deferrals ledger that seeds the next campaign.

p.THE-PLAN-SAYS-WHAT-SHOULD-HAPPEN-THE-LED: The plan says what should happen; the ledger says what did.

p.COMMITS-ALONE-CANNOT-CARRY-THE-COMPARISO: Commits alone cannot carry the comparison — a hash proves a change landed, not that it landed *as planned*, confirmed a prediction, or corrected a decision.

p.THE-LEDGER-BINDS-INTENT-TO-REAL-COMMITS: The ledger binds the two: every phase's real commits mapped onto the plan's intent, with divergence stated where it occurred.

p.A-FUTURE-READER-NEEDS-THIS-FILE-PLUS-GIT: A future reader audits the campaign from this file plus `git log` and needs nothing else.

p.the-status-line-is-the-lifecycle-indicat: The plan's status line is the campaign's single lifecycle indicator:

td.fact: authored; optionally annotated `ACCEPTED with owner amendments, <date>` after review
flipped when Phase 0 opens; since Phase 0 commits nothing, the flip rides the plan-amendment commit that records the Phase 0 findings, or Phase 1's first commit
flipped at close, together with the prepended execution record

p.THE-LINES-TAIL-IS-REFRESHED-AT-EVERY-LAT: At every later phase boundary the executing session refreshes the line's tail — "Phase N landed, floor green, next: Phase N+1" — as part of that phase's commit set.

p.THE-STATUS-LINE-MUST-NEVER-LAG-THE-TREE: The status line is what a cold session reads first; it must never lag the tree.

execution-record.title: The execution-record block

p.A-SUMMARY-BLOCK-IS-PREPENDED-AT-CLOSE: At close, a summary block is **prepended** into the plan's status area — the first thing any future reader sees, above the now-historic planning prose. It carries:

item.EXECUTION-RECORD-THE-PER-PHASE-DELTAS: the per-phase deltas against the target arithmetic,

item.EXECUTION-RECORD-THE-VERDICT-ON-EVERY-PR: and the verdict on every prediction.

execution-record.fence: _Execution record: all six phases ran to the exit state — baseline 130 → 10, exactly §0's arithmetic; 19 commits (`254b974` … `475fa75`). Two predictions falsified and recorded in place: the stale-trio premise (§0 correction) and the one-third waiver rate (3/24 actual — restructures dominated); the other four held. The journal carries the checkpoint._

p.note-the-shape-of-the-execution-record: Note the shape: exact counts against the plan's own §0, the hash range, falsifications named with their observed values, and a pointer to the project's journal for the session-level checkpoint.

commit-maps.title: Per-phase commit maps

p.EACH-EXECUTED-PHASE-GETS-A-LEDGER-SECTIO: Each executed phase gets a ledger section: `EXECUTED <date>` plus a commit map.

p.ONE-ENTRY-PER-COMMIT: One entry per commit — **hash, the conventional-commit subject, what it did, and what it confirmed or falsified**:

commit-maps.fence:
### Phase 3 — EXECUTED (2026-07-07); commit map
- `fdd6baf` feat(packages): the kind's first real inhabitant. TWO PLAN SIMPLIFICATIONS recorded: the planned library extraction proved unnecessary — the command-line layer already IS the library — and the version bump fell away with it: bump only what changes (D10 amended by execution). - `cf2e64c` build(deps): the project repins itself as the first consumer. - Panel at the boundary: full gate panel green; benchmark corpus 9/9 — no target moved.

p.THE-MAP-IS-WRITTEN-AT-THE-BOUNDARY-NOT-A: The map is written at the phase boundary, while the reasoning is fresh — not reconstructed at close.

p.DRIFTED-SUBJECTS-ARE-RECORDED-WITH-THE-D: Planned subjects that drifted during execution are recorded with the drift ("split into two commits: the fixture change deserved its own revert point").

p.the-ledgers-value-is-its-honesty-lead: The ledger's value is exactly proportional to its honesty:

item.HONESTY-SAY-NO-TARGET-MOVED-WHERE-IT-IS-: **Say "no target moved" where it is true.** A close panel that reports numbers without saying whether they shifted reads as concealment in audit. "Corpus 9/9 — no target moved" costs five words and closes the question.

item.HONESTY-EXECUTION-MAY-CORRECT-THE-PLAN-A: **Execution may correct the plan's own decisions — and says so.** The plan is not sacred; silent divergence is the sin. When execution proves a decision wrong or unnecessary, the ledger entry states it and the Decision is amended in place, as in the Phase 3 map above.

item.HONESTY-FALSIFIED-PREDICTIONS-ARE-FINDIN: **Falsified predictions are findings, not failures.** They are recorded twice: at the prediction (in place, so the planning prose never misleads a re-reader) and in the execution record's verdict list.

item.HONESTY-DISCOVERED-WORK-APPEARS-WITH-ITS: **Discovered work appears with its commits.** An entry that was not in the plan says so explicitly — the [`phase-gates.md` §discovered-work](phase-gates.md#discovered-work) rule, enforced at write time.

p.the-campaign-closes-by-checking-every-pr: The campaign closes by checking **every prediction, one by one**:

item.VERDICT-FALSIFIED: falsified (with the observed value and where the correction landed),

item.VERDICT-SURPRISED: or surprised (something happened the predictions never addressed).

p.THEN-THE-LESSONS: Then the lessons: which decisions execution amended, which rules or estimates misfired, what the next campaign inherits.

p.A-CAMPAIGN-THAT-SKIPS-THE-REPORT-LEARNS-: **A campaign that skips the report learns nothing durable.**

p.only-the-learning-compounds-across-campa: The work survives in the commits either way; the *learning* — which planning assumptions held, which estimates were systematically off — survives only here, and it is the only part that compounds across campaigns.

p.IN-THE-ONE-FILE-DIALECT-THE-REPORT-IS-NO: In the one-file dialect the report is not a separate document: it is the execution-record block plus the per-prediction verdicts recorded in place.

p.RUN-THE-ACCEPTANCE-SCRIPT-BEFORE-WRITING: Before writing it, run the whole-campaign acceptance script on a green floor; the report cites its output.

deferrals.title: The deferrals ledger

p.EVERY-DEFERRAL-IS-NAMED-WITH-AN-OWNER-AN: Everything the campaign chose not to do is **named** — one line each, with an owner (who decides its fate) and a disposition.

p.NOTHING-EVAPORATES: Nothing evaporates: at close, every piece of leftover work is either in a commit or in this ledger.

deferrals.fence: - DEF-3 — mirror publish: EXECUTABLE, held on the owner's word (policy, not capability). - DEF-5 — the second stack's gate step: waits for the demo project this campaign built as its prerequisite.

p.A-DEFERRAL-IS-NOT-A-TODO-A-PROMISE-OR-A-: A deferral is not a TODO comment in code, not a chat promise, not a mental note — those all evaporate.

p.A-DEFERRAL-LIVES-IN-THE-PLAN-FILE-UNTIL-: It lives in the plan file, under its campaign, until a later campaign drains it.

lineage.title: The lineage law

p.the-next-mandate-is-drained-from-the-def: The next campaign's mandate is drained **from** the deferrals ledger:

lineage.fence: Campaign A closes: "§15 DEF-3 — mirror publish stays held (owner call)." Campaign B opens: Mandate (owner, dated): "close every §15 deferral of campaign A." DEF-3 becomes Phase 4.

p.a-real-chain-anonymized: A real chain, anonymized: a self-sufficiency campaign closed with six named deferrals; later the owner's commissioning words for the follow-up were, in substance, "take everything listed in the previous campaign's deferral ledger and plan its implementation" — and the new plan's opening table mapped each of them to the phase that closes it.

p.THE-LEDGER-OF-ONE-CAMPAIGN-IS-THE-RAW-MA: The ledger of one campaign *is* the raw mandate of the next; the chain never breaks, and nothing is re-discovered from scratch.

item.SUM-THE-STATUS-LINE-IS-THE-LIFECYCLE: The status line is the lifecycle: PLANNED → EXECUTING → EXECUTED <date>, refreshed at every phase boundary.

item.SUM-AT-CLOSE-PREPEND-THE-EXECUTION-RECOR: At close, prepend the execution record: commit range, deltas against the arithmetic, a verdict on every prediction.

item.SUM-COMMIT-MAPS-BIND-HASHES-TO-PLANNED-S: Per-phase commit maps bind hashes to planned subjects and state what each commit confirmed or falsified — written at the boundary, not reconstructed later.

item.SUM-THE-HONESTY-RULES: Honesty rules: "no target moved" said aloud; corrected decisions said aloud; falsified predictions recorded in place.

item.SUM-SKIPPING-THE-REPORT-LEARNS-NOTHING-D: A campaign that skips the report learns nothing durable.

item.SUM-DEFERRALS-LIVE-IN-THE-LEDGER-AND-SEE: Deferrals live in the ledger, named and owned — and the next campaign's mandate drains from it.
